entity: US FDA-regulated finished trials that never posted results (national measure)
what_we_add: 706 trials, the 8.6% rate on a fixed 2017-2022 completion cohort, and 152,850 enrolled patients
why: FDA and Science/STAT state the finding in words: many covered trials never report. FDA's 29.6% is a different denominator (all currently overdue), so no same-window contradiction; our cohort count and patient total are new.
